title: Voulant honneur (CRIM Model 0012)
description: A sixteenth-century chanson by Pierre Sandrin, one of the 'model' pieces that Renaissance composers reworked into imitation masses, as encoded and studied by the CRIM project. The audio is a rendering from the encoded score. Included as a contrast to the field recordings: steady tuning, clean sustained voices and clear polyphonic structure.
credit: CRIM: Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (Richard Freedman, Haverford College)

title: Chopin, Mazurka Op. 41 No. 1 (Rubinstein)
description: Frédéric Chopin's Mazurka Op. 41 No. 1, played by Arthur Rubinstein. One of three recordings of the same piece included for comparison: the same notes in different hands, so differences in tempo, rubato, dynamics and touch show up directly in the tempogram, onset and loudness views.
